mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_coupon (user_id, coupon_id, status, receive_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{couponId}, 0, #{receiveTime})

INSERT INTO user_coupon (user_id, coupon_id, status, receive_time) VALUES
(#{item.userId}, #{item.couponId}, 0, #{item.receiveTime})
mapper.select: SELECT uc.*, c.id c_id, c.name c_name, c.type c_type, c.min_amount, c.reduce_amount, c.discount, c.end_time FROM user_coupon uc JOIN coupon c ON uc.coupon_id = c.id WHERE uc.id = #{id}

SELECT uc.*, c.id c_id, c.name c_name, c.type c_type, c.min_amount, c.reduce_amount, c.discount, c.end_time FROM user_coupon uc JOIN coupon c ON uc.coupon_id = c.id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.status = 0 AND c.status = 1 AND c.end_time > NOW() AND c.min_amount <= #{totalAmount} ORDER BY c.type, c.reduce_amount DESC
